parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) accurately and completely realize the high-level goal (HLG) of providing citizens with dual-view access to public reports. The LLGs cover the essential capabilities of displaying reports on an interactive map, in a summary table, applying filters, and sorting reports based on various criteria. All documented parent capabilities are present, supported, and distinct. There is no redundancy or missing essential capability in the provided LLGs.

The LLG's description aligns with the source evidence from the project description, specifically sections A (Reports) and C (Citizen Updates). The LLGs capture the functional interactions and effects required for citizens to view reports on an interactive map and summary table, with filtering and sorting options. These capabilities are document-supported automatic effects that do not require a manual trigger by the actor (citizen).

The decision is KEEP_LOW_LEVEL_GOALS due to the completeness, support, non-redundancy, and correct scope of the LLGs. No regeneration is required as all essential parent capabilities are adequately represented in the provided LLGs.
